issues.rationale: Birth timing normally seeks a calendar date, but no date is supplied and current date policy does not explicitly admit a bare requested calendar role.
Bare when does not establish clock time versus calendar date.
CNN is clearly a source, but whether this broadcaster reference also expresses an organizational identity versus only its channel is not settled.
Calendar may denote a task/event collection, but current list definition does not settle calendar-as-list scope.
Whether a calendar itself is a named task collection is an unresolved type boundary.
Query implies calendar entries but names no event category; calendar-entry inference versus expressed event reference is not settled by current rule.
Performer role is requested but unnamed; current artist_name requires a named performer, unlike person reference policy. Whether unspecified role counts requires task-level clarification.
Could repeat the reminder once or configure recurrence; no stable schedule is stated.
Schedule-as-task-collection is not settled by current list policy.
History-relative predicate may encode prior listening events or merely a selection attribute; represented-event threshold is not settled by wording.
Sunset may be an astronomical timing event rather than meteorological condition; current weather definition does not settle this inclusion.
Perfect could request an unspecified personal-quality criterion or be generic evaluative wording, not a defined attribute; cannot infer criteria.

policy: Batch triage; retain unavailable. No automatic ontology edits or input-specific rules; distinguish task-boundary questions from irreducible input ambiguity.
